messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Three-year post-doc position Ghent University (Belgium)
parts:
Dear all,

Please forward this job ad to those doctoral candidates or recent
graduates who may be looking for a position.

We have a three-year post-doc position in our SEMlab research group at
the Department of Data Analysis, Ghent University (Belgium). The
post-doc will work for on the project: "From SEM to SAM: extending and
evaluating the structural-after-measurement (SAM) approach to structural
equation modeling.", funded by the Flemish Research Foundation (FWO),
under the supervision of Prof. Yves Rosseel.

The full job ad can be found here:

https://jobs.ugent.be/job-invite/26820/

Applications should be submitted by May 1st, 2024, using the online
application system at https://jobs.ugent.be/job-invite/26820/

--
Yves Rosseel
Department of Data Analysis, Ghent University
